mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_case (id, workspace_id, req_id, demand_id, title, precondition, module, priority, steps, latest_status, latest_note, latest_by, latest_by_user_id, latest_at, latest_bug_task_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{demandId}, #{title}, #{precondition}, #{module}, #{priority}, #{steps}, #{latestStatus}, #{latestNote}, #{latestBy}, #{latestByUserId}, #{latestAt}, #{latestBugTaskId}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE test_case SET req_id = #{reqId}, demand_id = #{demandId}, title = #{title}, precondition = #{precondition}, module = #{module}, priority = #{priority}, steps = #{steps} WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

UPDATE test_case SET latest_status = #{status}, latest_note = #{note}, latest_by = #{by}, latest_by_user_id = #{byUserId}, latest_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment a WHERE a.target_kind = 'case_run' AND a.target_id = (SELECT r.id FROM test_case_run r WHERE r.case_id = c.id AND r.workspace_id = c.workspace_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1))
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.req_id, c.demand_id, d.title AS demand_title, c.title, c.precondition, c.module, c.priority, c.steps AS steps_json, c.latest_status, c.latest_note, c.latest_by, c.latest_at, c.latest_bug_task_id, t.title AS latest_bug_task_title, AS latest_evidence_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM test_case c LEFT JOIN demand d ON d.id = c.demand_id LEFT JOIN task t ON t.id = c.latest_bug_task_id WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.req_id = #{reqId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
SELECT latest_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId} AND latest_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY latest_status
mapper.sql: FROM test_case c LEFT JOIN demand d ON d.id = c.demand_id LEFT JOIN task t ON t.id = c.latest_bug_task_id
mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.req_id, c.demand_id, d.title AS demand_title, c.title, c.precondition, c.module, c.priority, c.steps AS steps_json, c.latest_status, c.latest_note, c.latest_by, c.latest_at, c.latest_bug_task_id, t.title AS latest_bug_task_title, AS latest_evidence_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{q.limit} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT DISTINCT module FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId} AND module IS NOT NULL AND module <> '' ORDER BY module

SELECT d.id AS demand_id, d.title AS demand_title, d.status AS demand_status, d.priority, COUNT(c.id) AS case_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS blocked, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL AND c.latest_status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS untested, COUNT(DISTINCT c.latest_bug_task_id) AS bug_count FROM demand d LEFT JOIN test_case c ON c.demand_id = d.id AND c.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND c.req_id = d.req_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.req_id = #{reqId} GROUP BY d.id, d.title, d.status, d.priority, d.created_at ORDER BY FIELD(d.status, 'review', 'pass', 'plan', 'rej'), d.created_at DESC, d.id

SELECT COUNT(c.id) AS case_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS blocked, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS untested, COUNT(DISTINCT c.latest_bug_task_id) AS bug_count FROM test_case c WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.req_id = #{reqId} AND (c.demand_id IS NULL OR c.demand_id NOT IN ( SELECT d.id FROM demand d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.req_id = #{reqId} ))
SELECT DISTINCT latest_by FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId} AND latest_by IS NOT NULL AND latest_by <> '' ORDER BY latest_by
